result.description: SPARTAN EQUIPMENTS AUSTRALIA PTY LTD   Key Responsibilities    Prepare detailed 2D fabrication drawings, 3D CAD models, layouts and engineering designs for transport equipment, trailers and related mechanical assemblies under the guidance of Mechanical Engineers, ensuring compliance with project specifications and manufacturing requirements.  Assist Mechanical Engineers and Engineering Technologists in the design, development and refinement of mechanical equipment, components and production systems by interpreting technical specifications, client requirements and engineering concepts.   Select appropriate drafting methods, CAD tools, design software and engineering resources to support efficient design development, manufacturing processes and project delivery.   Support the assembly and installation of new and modified mechanical assemblies, components and equipment by preparing accurate fabrication drawings, workshop documentation and technical instructions for production teams.   Estimate material quantities, prepare Bills of Materials (BOMs), determine component requirements and assist in assessing manufacturing resources and production needs for engineering projects.   Assist with engineering testing activities by reviewing design performance, evaluating manufacturing outcomes and supporting investigations to ensure equipment and components meet operational requirements.   Collect, analyse and interpret engineering data, perform technical calculations and prepare diagrams, drawings and documentation to support design development, manufacturing processes and project planning.   Coordinate and support inspection, quality assurance and maintenance activities by maintaining drawing registers, revision records and technical documentation to ensure the accuracy and traceability of engineering information.   Ensure all designs, drawings, fabrication documentation and completed work comply with applicable Australian Standards, engineering specifications, quality requirements, safety regulations and contractual obligations, while implementing modifications and continuous improvements where required.       Qualifications & Experience    Diploma or higher qualification in Engineering Drafting, Engineering Design, Mechanical Drafting, or a related field.   Minimum 1-3 years of relevant mechanical drafting experience.   Proficiency in CAD software such as SolidWorks, AutoCAD, and Inventor.   Strong knowledge of fabrication processes, manufacturing methods, materials, and tolerances.   Ability to read and interpret technical drawings and specifications accurately.   Excellent attention to detail, communication, and teamwork skills.      About Company     SPARTAN EQUIPMENTS AUSTRALIA PTY LTD (trading as Spartan Quip) is a Western Australian engineering and manufacturing company specialising in the design, fabrication and supply of heavy transport equipment and custom trailer solutions. The company manufactures a range of products including semi-trailers, tippers, drop deck trailers, skel trailers, dolly trailers and other specialised transport equipment for the transport, mining, construction and logistics industries. Spartan Quip provides engineering, drafting, manufacturing and compliance-focused solutions tailored to customer requirements and operates from its facility in Maddington, Western Australia .
